task: Step 3 of 30 — long-running platform refactor: define the service discovery strategy for the new microservices. Steps 1–2 complete. No decisions have been reversed yet; all memories are clean.

candidate_memories.content: Step 2 output: service mesh (Istio) chosen for service discovery; Consul considered and rejected due to operational overhead.
All new microservices must register with the Istio service registry via standard Kubernetes Service resources; no manual registration required.
Service naming convention: {service-name}.{namespace}.svc.cluster.local; use short names within the same namespace.
Service discovery strategy is a platform-wide decision; changes require an ADR and platform team approval.
Step 1 shortlist: Consul, Istio, and etcd-based custom discovery were evaluated.
